rows.claim: The yield is implicit in the coarse-phase sleep whenever that runs; an explicit yield() covers only the frames where it does not run (unpaced runs, pure-spin frames with budget <= margin)
rows.evidence: src/sim.jl:2107 `isempty(roster) || yield()` runs on every frame with a roster, before the pacer wait, whether or not the coarse sleep follows. src/control.jl:186 skips the sleep also for the frame after an anchor, a late (overrun) frame and a pace change re-anchor, which the doc's list omits.
rows.fix: The loop yields explicitly at every frame top while any device is rostered, ahead of the pacer's wait; the coarse-phase `sleep` is a further yield where it runs. A frame that skips the sleep (unpaced, budget <= margin, overrun or the frame after an anchor) yields through the explicit call alone.
rows.note: The log (design/log.md:1093) states the same narrower form as the spec, so the code and both records differ in how they describe it. The per-frame guarantee itself holds.
